_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Spot psychology is low-conviction drift so the ladder can grind one rung up into Complacency only if flows stay dead-flat; the bottom analog does not relocate the current score.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicitly HOLD into Complacency; narrative silent on forward phase and only supplies intake weakness
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 45-58 with funding near flat and 30d momentum between -8% and +5% while ETF flows stay dead-to-flat
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound with F&G through 62 and positive 30d momentum, or funding flips negative with F&G under 40 on a liquidation flush
